svg.title: F169.4 flat has no depth: a visitor talks to Orbi on a flat page

g.text: F169.4 flat has no depth: a visitor talks to Orbi on a flat page
opens Orbi and clicks in the typing row
a hairline inside the edge, and none
the row: its violet line and pale ring,
press-shadow() on the send, spoken() on
none, none, and the message's own colour
shimmer() on the line that says Orbi is
the words' own grey: nothing is seen to
the small ring beside the words still
the answer holds a picture: draw it for
its copy, with flat's rules: no glow,
the answer: a code block with a line

text.tspan: Each piece of the talk asks the surface tool, the tool asks the theme, and flat answers with a line or with none. The picture in the answer is the engine's, and wears
